papers.abstract_original: The recent growth of the digital economy and technological advances has created new patterns of FDI and international involvement. We contribute to the debate on nontraditional (NT) entry modes in a changing digital world—virtual presence, digital platforms, and innovation outposts. We provide fresh insights into real option theory (ROT) and MNE theory, explaining new forms of international involvement within a dynamic ROT portfolio perspective. We discuss uncertainty and correlation among market conditions, knowledge redundancy, how NT modes entail MNE growth and switching options, and how they contribute to the MNE option portfolio. We discuss information options and other real options embedded in NT modes, and the factors influencing their values. Our article has practical relevance as many MNEs do not incorporate real options into their decision-making processes. We encourage managers to understand that (1) uncertainty influences options beneficially, (2) NT modes create real options, and (3) these NT options create flexibility. Our ROT ‘portfolio’ perspective shows how uncertainty, market correlation, and knowledge diversity influence a real option’s contribution to MNE option portfolios, though they are context-specific. Finally, we compare how ROT insights complement those from existing MNE theories.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来数字经济的增长和技术进步创造了外商直接投资和国际参与的新模式。我们为关于不断变化的数字世界中非传统（NT）进入模式的辩论做出贡献——虚拟存在、数字平台和创新前哨。我们为实物期权理论（ROT）和跨国公司（MNE）理论提供了新的见解，从动态的ROT组合视角解释了国际参与的新形式。我们讨论了不确定性以及市场条件之间的相关性、知识冗余、NT模式如何带来跨国公司增长和转换期权，以及它们如何为跨国公司期权组合做出贡献。我们讨论了嵌入NT模式中的信息期权和其他实物期权，以及影响其价值的因素。我们的文章具有实际意义，因为许多跨国公司并未将实物期权纳入其决策过程。我们鼓励管理者理解：（1）不确定性对期权产生有利影响，（2）NT模式创造实物期权，（3）这些NT期权创造灵活性。我们的ROT“组合”视角展示了不确定性、市场相关性和知识多样性如何影响实物期权对跨国公司期权组合的贡献，尽管这些影响具有情境特定性。最后，我们比较了ROT的见解如何补充现有跨国公司理论的见解。

papers.abstract_original: Cultural products—characterized by rich artistic expression and symbolic meaning —are now produced and distributed globally at unprecedented speed. Yet as their reach expands, so too does resistance, as cultural goods become increasingly entangled in geopolitical tensions, cultural sensitivities. This paradox—of easier global access but more contested local acceptance—poses new strategic challenges for multinational enterprises (MNEs) in these industries and presents valuable opportunities for international business (IB) scholars to revisit foundational theories. In this article, we revisit the essence of culture and “classic” cultural industries, summarize the driving forces of “new” cultural industries, and present a typology that explains the competitive strategies of firms in these industries that are competing globally. Specifically, we propose a CASE framework that explains how firms can Connect, Assimilate, Showcase, and Enrich their place-based identity, depending on whether authenticity is location-bound or not, as well as whether foreignness is perceived as a liability or an asset. Finally, we summarize the six papers included in this special issue and conclude with directions for future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 文化产品——以丰富的艺术表达和象征意义为特征——如今以前所未有的速度在全球生产和分销。然而，随着其触达范围扩大，阻力也随之增加，因为文化商品日益卷入地缘政治紧张和文化敏感性之中。这一悖论——全球获取更容易，但本地接受更具争议——对这些行业中的跨国企业（MNE）构成了新的战略挑战，也为国际商务（IB）学者重新审视基础理论提供了宝贵机会。在本文中，我们重新审视文化的本质和“经典”文化产业，总结“新”文化产业的驱动力，并提出一个类型学，用以解释这些行业中在全球竞争的企业所采用的竞争战略。具体而言，我们提出一个CASE框架，解释企业如何根据真实性是否受地域约束，以及外来性被视为负担还是资产，来连接、吸收、展示和丰富其基于地域的身份。最后，我们总结本期特刊收录的六篇论文，并以未来研究方向作结。

papers.abstract_original: In this crowdsourced initiative, 57 independent analysts used the same longitudinal dataset to address four major empirical questions in international business. For all four research questions, different analysts obtained substantial estimates in opposite directions, meaning that they could have drawn any conclusion at all had they conducted the project alone. Aggregating across the results obtained by different analysts pointed to an overall answer for two of the four research questions, although for one of the two questions, the evidence was more suggestive than conclusive. That said, the variability in results was not simply random, and could in some cases be meaningfully explained. Choices regarding how to operationalize variables played an important role in determining the empirical results, and expert analysts were more likely to report large positive effects. Rather than exhibiting a bias to confirm their pre-existing beliefs, analysts appeared to rationally update their beliefs considering the evidence. Overall, these findings empirically demonstrate the role of subjective researcher choices in shaping results in international business research yet also show that it is still possible to draw meaningful conclusions in science. We advocate for an open science of international business in which the consequences of subjective analytic choices are rendered as transparent as possible.
papers.abstract_zh: 在这项众包倡议中，57位独立分析师使用相同的纵向数据集来探讨国际商务中的四个重大实证问题。对于所有四个研究问题，不同分析师得出了方向相反且幅度可观的估计结果，这意味着如果他们各自单独开展该项目，本可以得出任何结论。将不同分析师所得结果汇总后，为四个研究问题中的两个指向了一个总体答案，尽管对于其中两个问题之一，证据更具提示性而非结论性。话虽如此，结果中的变异性并非纯粹随机，在某些情况下可以得到有意义的解释。关于如何操作化变量的选择在决定实证结果方面发挥了重要作用，而专家分析师更有可能报告较大的正向效应。分析师并未表现出确认其既有信念的偏差，反而似乎会依据证据理性地更新其信念。总体而言，这些发现以实证方式证明了主观研究者选择在塑造国际商务研究结果中的作用，同时也表明在科学中仍有可能得出有意义的结论。我们倡导一种开放的国际商务科学，在其中主观分析选择的后果被尽可能透明地呈现。

papers.abstract_original: Firms often experience significant abnormal stock returns following major corporate events, but these returns vary widely across countries. We examine how national institutions—particularly financial system development, investor protection, and governance practices—influence post-event stock returns for over 164,000 events across 58 countries. Our analysis covers six frequent corporate events: dividend initiations, share repurchases, seasoned equity offerings, stock splits, mergers and acquisitions, and initial public offerings. Using a characteristic-based benchmarking approach that accounts for cross-country differences in firm fundamentals, we find that firms in countries with more developed financial systems and stronger investor protections exhibit significantly smaller long-run post-event abnormal returns. These findings are robust to alternative benchmarks and model specifications. Our results suggest that the institutional environment can reduce informational frictions and promote more efficient investor responses to corporate announcements. In countries with strong financial and governance institutions, market reactions to corporate events are more muted—indicating fewer pricing anomalies and more efficient capital markets. By demonstrating how national institutions help shape the outcomes of firm-level events, our study highlights the value of incorporating institutional context into international finance research and helps explain why post-event return patterns often differ across countries.
papers.abstract_zh: 企业往往在重大公司事件后出现显著的超常股票收益，但这些收益在各国之间差异很大。我们考察了国家制度——特别是金融体系发展、投资者保护和治理实践——如何影响58个国家超过164,000起事件的事件后股票收益。我们的分析涵盖六类常见的公司事件：首次发放股利、股份回购、增发股票、股票拆分、并购以及首次公开发行。我们采用基于特征的基准方法，该方法考虑了各国之间公司基本面的差异，发现金融体系更发达、投资者保护更强的国家的企业，其长期事件后超常收益显著更小。这些发现在替代基准和模型设定下均保持稳健。我们的结果表明，制度环境能够减少信息摩擦，并促进投资者对公司公告作出更有效的反应。在金融和治理制度较强的国家，市场对公司事件的反应更为温和——这表明定价异象更少、资本市场更有效率。通过展示国家制度如何帮助塑造企业层面事件的结果，我们的研究凸显了将制度背景纳入国际金融研究的价值，并有助于解释为何事件后收益模式在各国之间往往存在差异。

papers.abstract_original: Gender wage discrimination is a grand challenge that constrains economic growth worldwide and denies women fair opportunities. Yet, we know surprisingly little about how women’s own experiences of wage discrimination steer their career decisions. We adopt the perspective of job-seeking women and argue that prior exposure to wage discrimination reshapes their employer preferences. Specifically, it can flip the liability of foreignness typically faced by foreign MNCs into a perceived employer advantage because foreign MNCs can deviate from the host country’s gender-biased norms. We study this mechanism for 165,624 female professionals and managers who changed jobs in Denmark between 2002 and 2015, using a pay transparency law from 2006 for identifying the underlying mechanism. We find that women who have suffered larger wage discrimination in domestic employment are more likely to start working for foreign MNC subsidiaries. This effect is weaker in labor markets in which high-performing domestic employers can offer other benefits, such as reputation or job security. The effect is stronger when foreign MNC subsidiaries signal gender fairness through a higher share of women in management. Overall, our findings show how wage discrimination redirects female career paths, transforming a grand challenge into a strategic advantage for foreign MNCs.
papers.abstract_zh: 性别工资歧视是一项重大挑战，它制约着全球经济增长，并剥夺了女性公平的机会。然而，对于女性自身遭受工资歧视的经历如何影响其职业决策，我们知之甚少。我们采取求职女性的视角，认为先前遭受工资歧视的经历会重塑她们的雇主偏好。具体而言，这种经历可以将外国跨国公司通常面临的外来者劣势转变为一种感知到的雇主优势，因为外国跨国公司能够偏离东道国带有性别偏见的规范。我们以2002年至2015年间在丹麦更换工作的165,624名女性专业人士和管理者为研究对象，对这一机制进行了研究，并利用2006年的一项薪酬透明度法律来识别其内在机制。我们发现，在国内就业中遭受更大工资歧视的女性更有可能开始为外国跨国公司子公司工作。在那些高绩效的国内雇主能够提供其他好处（如声誉或工作保障）的劳动力市场中，这一效应较弱。当外国跨国公司子公司通过管理层中更高的女性比例来传递性别公平的信号时，这一效应更强。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，工资歧视如何改变了女性的职业路径，将一项重大挑战转变为外国跨国公司的战略优势。

papers.abstract_original: As artificial intelligence (AI) increasingly permeates international business (IB), it raises two critical questions for IB research: (1) How does AI reshape the external environment for firm internationalization? and (2) How do firms adapt their internationalization strategies within this AI-transformed landscape? To address the first question, we argue that the AI era is characterized by the coexistence of multiple AI ecosystems—each rooted in a country’s national AI sectoral system, yet globally interconnected through participants’ across-ecosystem activities. To address the second question, we propose multihoming—firms operating simultaneously across multiple AI ecosystems—as a strategy of internationalization in this new context. We identify three distinctive features of this multihoming perspective and discuss how it advances our understanding of firm internationalization while extending existing IB theories.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着人工智能（AI）日益渗透国际商务（IB），它给IB研究提出了两个关键问题：（1）AI如何重塑企业国际化的外部环境？（2）企业如何在这一被AI改变的环境中调整其国际化战略？为回答第一个问题，我们认为AI时代的特征是多个AI生态系统并存——每个生态系统植根于一国的国家AI部门体系，却通过参与者跨生态系统的活动而在全球范围内相互连接。为回答第二个问题，我们提出多栖——即企业在多个AI生态系统中同时运营——作为这一新情境下的一种国际化战略。我们识别出这一多栖视角的三个显著特征，并讨论它如何在拓展现有IB理论的同时，推进我们对企业国际化的理解。

papers.abstract_original: Does inward foreign direct investment (FDI) promote or inhibit the technological innovation of local firms? Prior research has generated mixed views and findings on this important question. To address this puzzle, we propose that FDI spillover and crowding-out effects may apply to different phases of innovation (i.e., idea generation and R&D implementation) respectively, which then leads to differential impacts of FDI on incremental and radical innovation. The results from a panel dataset of Chinese listed firms show that industry-level FDI is positively related to incremental innovation but has an inverted U-shaped impact on radical innovation. Furthermore, we find that technology gap reinforces the positive impact of FDI on incremental innovation while making its inverted U-shaped impact on radical innovation more pronounced, and when FDI local market focus is higher, the inverted U-shaped relationship between FDI and radical innovation is steeper. These findings reconcile the inconsistency regarding how FDI may affect local innovation and provide a novel analysis framework for the FDI literature.
papers.abstract_zh: 外商直接投资（FDI）流入是促进还是抑制了本土企业的技术创新？既有研究围绕这一重要问题得出了混杂的观点与发现。为解开这一谜题，我们提出，FDI的溢出效应与挤出效应可能分别作用于创新的不同阶段（即创意产生与研发实施），进而导致FDI对渐进式创新与突破式创新产生差异化影响。基于中国上市公司面板数据的结果显示，行业层面的FDI与渐进式创新正相关，但对突破式创新呈倒U形影响。此外，我们发现，技术差距强化了FDI对渐进式创新的正向影响，同时使其对突破式创新的倒U形影响更为显著；而当FDI的本地市场聚焦程度更高时，FDI与突破式创新之间的倒U形关系更为陡峭。这些发现调和了关于FDI如何影响本土创新的不一致之处，并为FDI文献提供了一个新颖的分析框架。

papers.abstract_original: E-commerce platforms can utilize managed ecosystems to integrate diverse, often globally dispersed participants, including users, sellers, and intermediaries. As key ecosystem participants, search engines play a critical role in channeling user traffic across borders. Through algorithmic matching of user queries with relevant product offerings, search engines enable managed ecosystems to adapt to cross-border demand shifts. Using the Russia–Ukraine conflict as an exogenous shock, we employ a difference-in-differences (DiD) design to analyze changes in foreign user traffic to e-commerce platforms in neighboring and non-neighboring countries. We find that neighboring countries’ platforms received a notable increase in international user traffic following the geopolitical conflict. This effect was particularly pronounced for e-commerce platforms that effectively optimized product keywords to target user search queries. Specifically, platforms can increase niche focus by targeting unique keywords that competitors neglect, or increase mass appeal by targeting popular keywords to reach a broad audience. Our findings highlight cross-border user traffic as a distinct form of international involvement, enabling e-commerce platforms to engage foreign users in cyberspace before transactions occur. By examining the pre-transactional user acquisition processes, this study advances the international business literature by introducing cross-border user traffic in managed ecosystems as a key pathway for digital internationalization.
papers.abstract_zh: 电子商务平台可以利用受管理的生态系统来整合多样化的、往往在全球分散的参与者，包括用户、卖家和中介。作为关键的生态系统参与者，搜索引擎在引导用户流量跨境流动方面发挥着关键作用。通过将用户查询与相关产品供给进行算法匹配，搜索引擎使受管理的生态系统能够适应跨境需求变化。以俄乌冲突作为外生冲击，我们采用双重差分（DiD）设计来分析邻国和非邻国电子商务平台外国用户流量的变化。我们发现，在地缘政治冲突之后，邻国平台接收到的国际用户流量显著增加。这一效应对于有效优化产品关键词以针对用户搜索查询的电子商务平台尤为明显。具体而言，平台可以通过针对竞争对手忽视的独特关键词来提高利基聚焦度，或通过针对热门关键词来触达广泛受众以提高大众吸引力。我们的发现凸显了跨境用户流量作为一种独特的国际参与形式，使电子商务平台能够在交易发生之前在网络空间中吸引外国用户。通过考察交易前的用户获取过程，本研究将受管理生态系统中的跨境用户流量引入为数字国际化的关键路径，从而推进了国际商务文献。

papers.abstract_original: This study analyzes the impact of digital transformation on manufacturing multinational enterprises’ (MNEs) offshore outsourcing intensity. We distinguish two independent categories of digital transformation: information-centric (IDT) and manufacturing-centric (MDT). Applying transaction costs economics (TCE), we argue that IDT decreases offshore outsourcing intensity, while MDT increases it. These effects arise from their respective influences on the specificity of an MNE’s core value-adding transactional assets, the frequency and variability of its demand for complementary inputs, and uncertainty in market transactions. Additionally, we identify internal and external factors that provide regulatory and relational safeguards for market transactions, thereby moderating these effects. We empirically test our hypotheses using 3271 firm-year observations from 492 Korean manufacturing MNEs between 2011 and 2021. Our findings offer strong support for our hypotheses, underscoring TCE’s relevance to understanding MNEs’ global supply chain governance under digital transformation.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究分析了数字化转型对制造业跨国企业（MNE）离岸外包强度的影响。我们区分了两类相互独立的数字化转型：以信息为中心的数字化转型（IDT）和以制造为中心的数字化转型（MDT）。运用交易成本经济学（TCE），我们论证IDT会降低离岸外包强度，而MDT会提高离岸外包强度。这些效应源于二者分别对跨国企业核心增值交易资产的专用性、其对互补性投入需求的发生频率与可变性，以及市场交易中的不确定性所产生的影响。此外，我们识别出为市场交易提供规制性与关系性保障的内部和外部因素，从而对这些效应起到调节作用。我们使用2011年至2021年间492家韩国制造业跨国企业的3271个企业—年度观测值对我们的假设进行了实证检验。我们的发现为我们的假设提供了有力支持，凸显了TCE在理解数字化转型背景下跨国企业全球供应链治理方面的相关性。

papers.abstract_original: Managers’ identities in large matrixed MNE structures are complex and pliable. While research has examined the identities of individual actors located in headquarters (HQ) or local subsidiaries, the unique identity challenges faced by those operating outside these conventional units are less predictable. Our study explores how managers experience and manage a ‘liminal identity’—feeling ‘betwixt and between’ multiple identity positions. Focusing on US MNEs in the life sciences sector, we interviewed managers who assumed global responsibilities from corporate HQ while remaining situated in their local (Irish) subsidiary. We find that operating between corporate HQ, a global network, and the local subsidiary forged a liminal identity. Straddling this local–corporate–global nexus was a profoundly ambiguous, precarious, and destabilizing experience. Yet, individuals also sought to leverage their liminal identity by adopting multiple identities, depending on the audience. This involved ‘switching’ between renouncing a local identity, assimilating a corporate identity and co-constructing a global identity. However, this produced an intense identity struggle, eroding a clear sense of self and belonging. Our study cautions firms to be attentive when supporting managers in these ‘in-between’ spaces to avoid the trap of ‘identity limbo’, where individuals risk becoming disconnected and isolated.
papers.abstract_zh: 在大型矩阵式跨国公司结构中，管理者的身份是复杂且可塑的。尽管已有研究考察了位于总部或本地子公司的个体行动者的身份，但对于在这些常规单元之外运作的人所面临的独特身份挑战，则较难预测。我们的研究探讨管理者如何体验和管理一种“阈限身份”——即在多个身份位置之间感到“亦此亦彼、非此非彼”。我们聚焦于生命科学领域的美国跨国公司，访谈了那些从公司总部承担全球职责、但仍身处其本地（爱尔兰）子公司的管理者。我们发现，在公司总部、全球网络与本地子公司之间运作，锻造出一种阈限身份。跨越这一本地—公司—全球交汇处，是一种极其模糊、不稳定且具有去稳定作用的体验。然而，个体也试图通过根据受众不同而采用多重身份来利用其阈限身份。这涉及在放弃本地身份、同化公司身份与共同建构全球身份之间进行“切换”。然而，这产生了强烈的身份挣扎，侵蚀了清晰的自我感与归属感。我们的研究提醒企业，在支持处于这些“中间”空间的管理者时应保持关注，以避免陷入“身份悬置”的陷阱，即个体面临变得脱节和孤立的风险。

papers.abstract_original: Our study, grounded in the multimarket competition, knowledge management, and technological change literature, investigates how multimarket contacts among multinational enterprises—i.e., the extent to which rival multinational enterprises meet simultaneously in multiple countries—shape their innovation and patent litigation decisions in host countries. We propose that the degree of multimarket contacts a multinational enterprise has with its competitors in a host country may restrain it from aggressively launching product and technological innovations in that country due to a fear of cross-country retaliation. However, increased multimarket contacts also facilitate knowledge diffusion, heightening the risk of imitation, and consequently enhance the multinational enterprise’s patent litigation intensity—a means to protect knowledge-based resources—in that country. Moreover, we examine how two features of the host-country technological environment—technological ferment (an era of intense technical variation following a technological discontinuity until a dominant design emerges) and home–host country differences in intellectual property protection—moderate these relationships. We test our hypotheses using a dataset of 85 mobile phone vendors, which includes data on their products and technological innovations and litigation cases in 46 countries between 2003 and 2015. This study sheds light on the interplay among multinational enterprises’ multimarket contacts, innovation, and patent litigation.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们的研究以多市场竞争、知识管理与技术变革文献为基础，考察跨国企业之间的多市场接触——即相互竞争的跨国企业在多个国家同时相遇的程度——如何塑造其东道国的创新与专利诉讼决策。我们提出，跨国企业与其竞争对手在东道国的多市场接触程度，可能因担心跨国家报复而抑制其在该国积极推出产品和技术创新。然而，多市场接触的增加也会促进知识扩散，提高被模仿的风险，从而增强跨国企业在该国的专利诉讼强度——这是一种保护知识型资源的手段。此外，我们考察东道国技术环境的两个特征——技术发酵（在技术不连续之后、主导设计出现之前，技术变异剧烈的时期）以及母国与东道国在知识产权保护上的差异——如何调节这些关系。我们使用包含85家手机厂商的数据集检验我们的假设，该数据集包括这些厂商2003年至2015年间在46个国家的产品与技术创新以及诉讼案件数据。本研究揭示了跨国企业的多市场接触、创新与专利诉讼之间的相互作用。

papers.abstract_original: Stephan, Uhlaner and Stride’s (2015) JIBS Decade Award-winning article provides a nuanced understanding of the national contexts that encourage social entrepreneurship. In this commentary, we build on their foundation and discuss the notion of social entrepreneurship further, shifting focus from individual engagement in social entrepreneurship to a consideration of social venture impact. This entails a shift from the individual as the unit of analysis to the social venture. Building on the ten years of social entrepreneurship research since Stephan, Uhlaner and Stride (2015) appeared, we examine the inevitable stakeholder multiplicity of social ventures, and the concomitant mission drift and mission motility that accompany it. We then discuss issues associated with measuring and scaling social venture impact, and options for studying the international factors affecting social venture impact. Throughout the article, we highlight the implications of these ideas for future international business research.

papers.abstract_original: While geopolitical conflicts, including trade wars, have garnered substantial scholarly attention in recent years, the impact on the outsider firms not directly involved in such conflicts remains underexplored. Engaging in real-options informed analysis, we examine how MNEs from third countries may respond to trade wars by capitalizing on the potential for competitive opportunities: where trade wars prompt the scaling up of third-country subsidiary operations in the involved countries. We further explore how the strategic responses of third-country MNEs to the opportunities presented by a trade war can be enhanced by the strategic flexibility manifest in parent-MNE multinationality, the resources and networks embedded in local partners, and the presence of bilateral economic agreements. Employing the 2018 US–China trade war as an empirical context, our panel data encompass 3601 Chinese subsidiary operations for outsider MNEs hailing from 51 countries, which yields 14,404 annual subsidiary-level observations to conduct difference-in-differences analysis. The empirical results indicate that third-country MNEs disproportionately expanded their Chinese operations in response to the US–China tariff conflict, and that these strategic responses were pronounced for subsidiaries with highly multinational parents, local partnerships in the involved country, and a home–host country bilateral agreement.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管近年来地缘政治冲突（包括贸易战）已引起大量学术关注，但对未直接卷入此类冲突的外部企业所受到的影响，仍缺乏充分探讨。我们采用实物期权启发的分析，考察第三国跨国企业如何通过利用竞争性机会的潜力来应对贸易战：即贸易战促使第三国子公司在相关国家扩大运营规模。我们进一步探讨，第三国跨国企业对贸易战所呈现机会的战略反应，如何能够因母公司跨国企业跨国性所体现的战略灵活性、嵌入当地合作伙伴的资源与网络，以及双边经济协定的存在而得到增强。我们以2018年美中贸易战作为实证情境，面板数据涵盖来自51个国家的外部跨国企业在中国的3601家子公司运营，产生14,404个年度子公司层面观测值，用以进行双重差分分析。实证结果表明，第三国跨国企业因美中关税冲突而超比例地扩大了其在华运营，且这些战略反应对于母公司高度跨国化、在相关国家拥有当地合作伙伴、以及母国—东道国之间存在双边协定的子公司而言尤为显著。

papers.abstract_original: Cross-border nonmarket strategy—multinational enterprises’ choice of nonmarket strategic actions in pursuit of profitability in a host market—is an essential part of international business. Recent calls for research assert, however, that very little is known about how multinational enterprises choose among cross-border nonmarket strategies. We thus propose that egalitarianism—one type of home-country informal institution—is a key predictor of an important set of cross-border nonmarket strategy choices, particularly among corporate political activities with varying degrees of transparency. We further test this argument by incorporating a firm-level corporate governance measure related to transparency to see how the firm-level corporate governance moderates the main effect. Our study contributes to international business and nonmarket strategy research by highlighting the importance of home-country informal institutions as well as host-country formal institutions as a guiding principle in cross-border nonmarket strategy.
papers.abstract_zh: 跨境非市场战略——跨国企业在东道国市场为追求盈利而选择非市场战略行动——是国际商务的重要组成部分。然而，近期研究呼吁指出，关于跨国企业如何在跨境非市场战略之间进行选择，人们所知甚少。因此，我们提出，平等主义——母国非正式制度的一种类型——是一组重要的跨境非市场战略选择的关键预测因素，尤其是在透明度程度不同的企业政治活动之中。我们进一步通过纳入一项与透明度相关的企业层面公司治理指标来检验这一论点，以考察企业层面公司治理如何调节主效应。我们的研究强调了母国非正式制度以及东道国正式制度作为跨境非市场战略指导原则的重要性，从而为国际商务与非市场战略研究做出了贡献。

papers.abstract_original: Born-digital firms increasingly pursue virtual involvement, a digital market-entry strategy that prioritizes iterative data collection and algorithmic adaptation over physical expansion. We measure virtual involvement by the number of unique digital advertisements and define it as the intensity of a firm’s digital experimentation to collect user data, train algorithms, and enable continuous learning through a recursive feedback loop. Using a novel panel dataset covering 194 US and Chinese born-digital firms across 33 countries from 2016 to 2022, our empirical analysis finds that stringent host-country digital privacy regulation significantly reduces virtual involvement. This negative influence is weakened in larger digital markets, for firms from home countries with robust digital regulatory regimes, and when firms receive positive public sentiment. These results extend institutional theory and non-traditional entry mode research by introducing virtual involvement as a new dimension of international strategy under regulatory constraints. For policymakers and managers, our study offers actionable guidance: strict privacy rules protect user welfare, but supportive market conditions and regulatory experience are critical to sustaining data-driven innovation. Policymakers should balance user protection with market dynamism, while firms should leverage large markets and positive sentiment to maintain their virtual involvement.
papers.abstract_zh: 生而数字化企业日益追求虚拟参与，这是一种数字市场进入策略，优先考虑迭代式数据收集和算法适应，而非实体扩张。我们以独特数字广告的数量来衡量虚拟参与，并将其定义为企业进行数字实验的强度，以收集用户数据、训练算法，并通过递归反馈回路实现持续学习。我们使用一个涵盖2016年至2022年间33个国家194家美国和中国生而数字化企业的新颖面板数据集，实证分析发现，东道国严格的数字隐私监管显著降低了虚拟参与。这种负面影响在更大的数字市场中、对于来自拥有健全数字监管制度的母国的企业，以及当企业获得积极公众情绪时会被削弱。这些结果通过引入虚拟参与作为监管约束下国际战略的新维度，扩展了制度理论和非传统进入模式研究。对于政策制定者和管理者，我们的研究提供了可操作的指导：严格的隐私规则保护用户福利，但支持性的市场条件和监管经验对于维持数据驱动创新至关重要。政策制定者应在用户保护与市场活力之间取得平衡，而企业应利用大市场和积极情绪来维持其虚拟参与。

papers.abstract_original: This study investigates how institutional investors approach multinational companies (MNCs) with ties to tax havens by analyzing their ownership patterns. Leveraging quarterly holdings data from over 15,000 investors spanning 90 countries and more than 20,000 MNCs, we uncover that institutional ownership is noticeably higher for firms incorporated in tax havens compared to those merely operating subsidiaries there. Investors are especially drawn to the tax rate differential between a firm’s incorporation country and domicile country. Yet, our findings reveal that institutional investors do not overlook the importance of a robust governance framework. Institutional ownership is higher in firms in countries with stronger governance standards, suggesting a balancing of tax benefits against governance risks. We further differentiate between independent and pressure-sensitive institutional investors, reporting that independent institutions are particularly focused on maximizing tax efficiency and ensuring high governance quality, while pressure-sensitive investors exhibit less pronounced preferences. Our research highlights the nuanced trade-offs institutional investors must weigh when considering MNCs with tax haven exposure, emphasizing that both tax advantages and governance considerations play pivotal roles in shaping investment strategies. These insights deepen our understanding of global investment behavior and inform policy debates about the complex interplay between taxation, governance, and multinational corporate structure.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究通过分析机构投资者的持股模式，考察他们如何对待与避税天堂有关联的跨国公司（MNC）。利用来自90个国家、超过15,000名投资者以及20,000多家跨国公司的季度持股数据，我们发现，在避税天堂注册成立的公司，其机构持股比例明显高于仅在那里设有运营子公司的公司。投资者尤其被公司注册国与住所国之间的税率差异所吸引。然而，我们的研究结果揭示，机构投资者并未忽视健全治理框架的重要性。在治理标准较强的国家，公司的机构持股比例更高，这表明投资者会在税收收益与治理风险之间进行权衡。我们进一步区分了独立型机构投资者与压力敏感型机构投资者，并报告称，独立型机构尤其专注于最大化税收效率并确保高治理质量，而压力敏感型投资者则表现出不那么明显的偏好。我们的研究凸显了机构投资者在考虑存在避税天堂敞口的跨国公司时必须权衡的微妙取舍，强调税收优势与治理考量在塑造投资策略中都发挥着关键作用。这些洞见加深了我们对全球投资行为的理解，并为关于税收、治理与跨国公司结构之间复杂相互作用的政策辩论提供了参考。

papers.abstract_original: Despite the increasing recognition of digital globalization in international business (IB) literature, there is a more pressing need for a comprehensive understanding of the unprecedented power generated by big-tech multinational enterprises (MNEs). This paper suggests that harnessing data ubiquity globally, instantaneously, and continuously represents a defining feature and a revolutionary power source for big-tech MNEs. By leveraging global data value chains through  a mutually reinforcing data-AI feedback loop of data access, analysis, and application, big-tech MNEs can reshape IB practices and challenge global regulatory frameworks. Drawing on power-dependence theory, our research framework highlights a logic of power mutuality characterized by the interplay between power generation and power counterbalance. These two forces provide a holistic lens for examining how big-tech MNEs create data-based power, but are simultaneously countered by the economic and sociopolitical stakeholders of big-tech MNEs. We propose promising avenues for future research on MNEs’ data strategies, global data value chains, foreignness and liabilities of data, and global data governance.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管国际商务（IB）文献日益认识到数字全球化，但更迫切需要一个全面的理解，以把握大型科技跨国企业（MNEs）所生成的空前权力。本文提出，在全球范围内、即时且持续地利用数据，是大型科技跨国企业的一个决定性特征和一种革命性的权力来源。通过数据获取、分析和应用的相互强化的数据—人工智能反馈循环，利用全球数据价值链，大型科技跨国企业能够重塑国际商务实践并挑战全球监管框架。基于权力依赖理论，我们的研究框架强调了一种权力相互性的逻辑，其特征是权力生成与权力制衡之间的相互作用。这两种力量提供了一个整体视角，用以考察大型科技跨国企业如何创造基于数据的权力，但同时又如何受到大型科技跨国企业的经济和社会政治利益相关者的制衡。我们提出了未来研究的有前景方向，涉及跨国企业的数据战略、全球数据价值链、外来者身份与数据责任以及全球数据治理。

papers.abstract_original: In this retrospective, we expand on theorizing about institutions and social entrepreneurship (SE) as presented in our Decade Award-winning 2015 article. Our 2015 paper developed the institutional configuration perspective, which considers joint and interaction effects of formal and informal institutions. It organized disagreement about how formal institutions shape SE, contrasting the institutional voids and institutional support perspectives. In this retrospective, we introduce a revised hierarchy of institutions as a ‘middle-ground’ approach to advance research on institutions in international business and entrepreneurship. This hierarchy integrates insights from different disciplines (institutional economics, sociology, political science, and cultural theory). It explicates the macro-level economic and microfoundational psychological effects of four layers of formal (government activism and constitutional institutions/rule of law) and informal institutions (cultural values and norms). The hierarchy progresses research on institutional voids by distinguishing four types of formal and informal institutional voids. It advances research on institutional configurations by highlighting new synergistic and compensatory configurations. It also offers new insights into institutional change. Finally, we advance research on institutions and SE by theorizing a new institutional paradox for SE that reconciles the institutional void versus support debate and by charting opportunities for how institutions shape the SE process from entry to exit.
papers.abstract_zh: 在这篇回顾性文章中，我们对我们获得十年奖的2015年文章中关于制度与社会创业（SE）的理论构建进行了拓展。我们2015年的论文提出了制度构型视角，该视角考虑了正式制度与非正式制度的联合效应和交互效应。它梳理了关于正式制度如何塑造社会创业的分歧，对比了制度空洞视角与制度支持视角。在这篇回顾性文章中，我们引入了一个修订后的制度层级，作为一种“中间立场”方法，以推进国际商务与创业研究中关于制度的研究。这一层级整合了不同学科（制度经济学、社会学、政治学和文化理论）的洞见。它阐明了四个层面的正式制度（政府能动主义与宪制制度/法治）和非正式制度（文化价值观与规范）在宏观层面的经济效应和微观基础层面的心理效应。该层级通过区分四种类型的正式与非正式制度空洞，推进了关于制度空洞的研究。它通过强调新的协同型与补偿型构型，推进了关于制度构型的研究。它还为制度变迁提供了新的洞见。最后，我们通过理论化一种新的社会创业制度悖论来推进关于制度与社会创业的研究，这一悖论调和了制度空洞与制度支持之争，并勾勒了制度如何塑造社会创业从进入到退出全过程的机会。

papers.abstract_original: Stephan, Uhlaner, and Stride’s (J Int Bus Stud 46:308–331, 2015) Decade Award-winning paper highlights how formal and informal institutional antecedents shape the emergence of social entrepreneurship across borders, while their 2026 retrospective extended attention to the enduring impact of social ventures. The Reuber and Fischer (J Int Bus Stud, 2026) commentary extended the conversation to emphasize the organizational impact of social ventures. Yet, while the retrospective and Reuber and Fischer’s (J Int Bus Stud, 2026) commentary emphasize how social ventures evolve and generate impact over time, they stop short of fully exploring how entrepreneurial action itself brings institutions and stakeholders into being. This commentary builds on the award-winning paper, the retrospective, and Reuber and Fischer’s commentary, while drawing on Creation Theory (Alvarez and Barney in Strateg Entrep J 1:11–26, 2007; Alvarez and Sachs in Acad Manag Rev 48:187–202, 2023) to reframe social entrepreneurship as a generative process in which opportunities, institutions, and stakeholders emerge together through cycles of action, interpretation, and shared experience under conditions of uncertainty. This perspective shows how entrepreneurs and stakeholders not only adapt to institutional environments but also actively create and reconfigure them. This reframing opens new directions: examining how entrepreneurial processes generate novel institutional forms across borders, how stakeholder roles are negotiated and renegotiated across cultural contexts, and how social ventures reshape the very landscapes in which they operate.
papers.abstract_zh: Stephan、Uhlaner和Stride（J Int Bus Stud 46:308–331, 2015）荣获十年奖的论文强调了正式与非正式制度前因如何塑造跨国社会创业的涌现，而其2026年的回顾则进一步关注社会企业持久的影响。Reuber和Fischer（J Int Bus Stud, 2026）的评论将讨论扩展至强调社会企业的组织影响。然而，尽管该回顾以及Reuber和Fischer（J Int Bus Stud, 2026）的评论强调了社会企业如何随时间演变并产生影响力，它们并未充分探讨创业行动本身如何使制度与利益相关者得以生成。本评论以该获奖论文、回顾以及Reuber和Fischer的评论为基础，同时借鉴创造理论（Alvarez and Barney in Strateg Entrep J 1:11–26, 2007; Alvarez and Sachs in Acad Manag Rev 48:187–202, 2023），将社会创业重新框定为一种生成过程，在此过程中，机会、制度与利益相关者在不确定性条件下通过行动、解释与共享经验的循环共同涌现。这一视角表明，创业者与利益相关者不仅适应制度环境，还主动创造并重构制度环境。这一重新框定开辟了新的方向：考察创业过程如何跨越国界生成新颖的制度形式，利益相关者角色如何在文化情境中被协商与再协商，以及社会企业如何重塑其运营所处的整个图景。

papers.abstract_original: Using a global dataset, we document that an increase in country-level climate vulnerability, measured by exposure, sensitivity, and adaptive capacity to the negative effects of climate change, results in an increase in firm-level stock price crash risk. Among these components, adaptive capacity exhibits the most prominent and persistent explanatory power. We confirm our main findings using an instrumental variable approach and exploring two regulatory shocks that tend to generate worldwide or within-country variations in adaptive capacity. In addition, we show that greater climate vulnerability is associated with weaker firm fundamentals, more aggressive bad news hoarding, and narrower institutional ownership breadth, all of which tend to trigger future stock price crashes. Moreover, the main effect varies with institutional or cultural differences across countries. Our overall findings indicate that climate vulnerability has adverse stock market consequences through a pronounced destabilizing effect. These findings highlight the critical role of formal and informal institutions in mitigating and adapting to climate change, an important issue for business operations and policymakers worldwide. International investors and multinational corporations should closely monitor country-level policies and initiatives aimed at enhancing climate resilience when selecting investees and managing global supply chains.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们利用一个全球数据集，记录了以对气候变化负面影响的暴露度、敏感性和适应能力衡量的国家层面气候脆弱性上升，会导致企业层面股价崩盘风险增加。在这些组成部分中，适应能力表现出最突出且最持久的解释力。我们使用工具变量方法，并考察两个倾向于产生全球范围或一国内部适应能力差异的监管冲击，以确认我们的主要发现。此外，我们表明，更高的气候脆弱性与更弱的企业基本面、更激进的坏消息囤积以及更窄的机构持股广度相关，而所有这些都倾向于引发未来的股价崩盘。而且，这一主效应随各国制度或文化差异而变化。我们的总体发现表明，气候脆弱性通过显著的去稳定化效应，对股票市场产生不利后果。这些发现凸显了正式和非正式制度在减缓和适应气候变化中的关键作用，这对全球企业运营和政策制定者而言都是一个重要问题。国际投资者和跨国公司在选择投资对象和管理全球供应链时，应密切关注旨在增强气候韧性的国家层面政策和举措。

papers.abstract_original: The world is witnessing an increase in interorganizational conflicts across borders, yet their impact on firms’ international expansion remains largely underexplored. Building on intergroup contact theory, we theorize that involvement in conflict with a foreign firm constitutes a form of negative intergroup contact, which can spill over into broader unfavorable attitudes—not only toward the specific foreign entity involved but also toward the foreign market more generally. Specifically, we predict that involvement in international litigation discourages a firm from undertaking international expansion. Furthermore, this negative spillover effect can be mitigated by trust radius—the width of the cooperation circle within a society. Firms embedded in regions with a wider trust radius and hence accustomed to interacting with diverse groups are less affected by international litigation. Results from a sample of Chinese publicly listed firms support our hypotheses. By testing and extending intergroup contact theory in international business research, we establish a theoretical link between interorganizational conflict and international expansion, and we also highlight trust radius as a key contributing factor to firms’ intergroup contact dynamics.
papers.abstract_zh: 全球范围内跨境的跨组织冲突日益增多，但其对企业国际扩张的影响在很大程度上仍未得到充分探讨。基于群际接触理论，我们提出理论认为，与外国企业发生冲突构成一种消极的群际接触，这种接触会外溢为更广泛的不利态度——不仅针对所涉的特定外国实体，也针对更一般意义上的外国市场。具体而言，我们预测，卷入国际诉讼会抑制企业进行国际扩张。此外，这种消极外溢效应可以被信任半径——一个社会中合作圈的宽度——所缓解。嵌入在信任半径更宽、因而习惯于与多元群体互动的地区的企业，受国际诉讼的影响较小。来自中国上市公司样本的结果支持了我们的假设。通过在国际商务研究中检验并扩展群际接触理论，我们建立了跨组织冲突与国际扩张之间的理论联系，并且我们还强调了信任半径是企业群际接触动态的一个关键促成因素。

papers.abstract_original: The United Nations’ 17 Sustainable Development Goals provide a framework for categorizing research that addresses global challenges and advances societal wellbeing. Using multiple large language models, this study analyzed 47,197 articles published in 18 business and management journals, including the Journal of International Business Studies , representing five business and management disciplines over 55 years (1970–2024). The objective was to assess the extent to which scholars, including those in IB, are tackling issues related to grand challenges as captured by the United Nation’s 17 Sustainable Development Goals. Findings show that among the 47,197 articles, 17.4% relate to one or more SDGs. This percentage increased over time, from 8% before the introduction of UN Agenda 21 in 1992 to 31% after the launch of UN Agenda 2030 in 2015. SDGs 8 (Decent Work and Economic Growth), 9 (Industry, Innovation, and Infrastructure), and 16 (Peace, Justice, and Strong Institutions) accounted for 78% of the SDG-aligned articles. The JIBS is among the leading journals contributing to these SDGs. We offer suggestions on how IB research can contribute to societal wellbeing by paying more attention to complementarities among goals and exploration of trade-offs where progress on one goal may impede advancement on another.
papers.abstract_zh: 联合国17项可持续发展目标为归类应对全球挑战和促进社会福祉的研究提供了一个框架。本研究使用多个大语言模型，分析了18种商业与管理期刊（包括《国际商务研究杂志》）在55年间（1970—2024年）发表的47,197篇文章，这些期刊代表五个商业与管理学科。目标是评估学者（包括国际商务领域的学者）在多大程度上正在处理联合国17项可持续发展目标所涵盖的重大挑战相关问题。研究结果显示，在这47,197篇文章中，17.4%与一项或多项可持续发展目标相关。这一比例随时间上升，从1992年联合国《21世纪议程》提出之前的8%，上升到2015年联合国《2030年议程》启动之后的31%。可持续发展目标8（体面工作与经济增长）、9（产业、创新和基础设施）和16（和平、正义与强大机构）占与可持续发展目标一致文章的78%。《国际商务研究杂志》是推动这些可持续发展目标的领先期刊之一。我们就国际商务研究如何通过更加关注各目标之间的互补性，并探索某一目标取得进展可能阻碍另一目标推进的权衡取舍，从而为社会福祉作出贡献提出了建议。

papers.abstract_original: Most research on bottom-up innovation emphasizes that employees innovate by embracing uncertainty, a view rooted in Anglo-Saxon cultures that value risk-taking. However, countries influenced by Confucian traditions, which prioritize harmony and conflict avoidance, also achieve strong innovation outcomes, presenting a cultural paradox. We address this paradox by introducing face concerns, the desire to maintain or enhance one’s social image, as a culturally specific mechanism shaping innovation behavior. We conceptualize innovation uncertainty as twofold, involving task uncertainty and social uncertainty. The presence of innovative coworkers reduces task uncertainty and encourages innovation, but also increases social uncertainty, activating culturally distinct face concerns. In Anglo-Saxon contexts, promotion-focused face concern drives employees low in uncertainty avoidance to engage in overt innovation. In contrast, in Confucian contexts, prevention-focused face concern leads employees high in uncertainty avoidance to pursue covert innovation. We test these hypotheses through two studies, a scenario-based experiment and a multi-country survey conducted in the United States, the United Kingdom, Japan, and China. Findings support our predictions, revealing that cultural orientations shape how employees navigate innovation uncertainty. This research advances understanding of bottom-up innovation by highlighting the culturally contingent mechanisms that foster distinct forms of innovative behavior.
papers.abstract_zh: 大多数关于自下而上创新的研究强调，员工通过拥抱不确定性来进行创新，这一观点根植于重视冒险的盎格鲁-撒克逊文化。然而，受儒家传统影响、优先考虑和谐与避免冲突的国家同样取得了强劲的创新成果，这构成了一个文化悖论。我们通过引入面子顾虑——即维持或提升自身社会形象的愿望——作为一种塑造创新行为的文化特定机制，来回应这一悖论。我们将创新不确定性概念化为两个方面，涉及任务不确定性和社会不确定性。创新型同事的存在降低了任务不确定性并鼓励创新，但也增加了社会不确定性，从而激活了文化上不同的面子顾虑。在盎格鲁-撒克逊情境中，促进导向的面子顾虑驱动低不确定性规避的员工从事公开创新。相比之下，在儒家情境中，预防导向的面子顾虑导致高不确定性规避的员工追求隐蔽创新。我们通过两项研究检验这些假设：一项基于情境的实验，以及一项在美国、英国、日本和中国进行的多国调查。研究结果支持了我们的预测，揭示出文化取向塑造了员工如何应对创新不确定性。本研究通过强调培育不同形式创新行为的文化权变机制，推进了对自下而上创新的理解。

papers.abstract_original: To examine heterogeneity in the internationalization of digital firms, we introduce the concept of “digital dampening”, which refers to the extent to which non-digital elements are integrated into a digital firm. We argue that digital dampening inhibits internationalization. We develop testable hypotheses about the international multihoming of smartphone apps from China and analyze rich data on 33,878 smartphone apps from 25,233 Chinese vendors on the Tencent app market. Our methodology leverages generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) in conjunction with latent Dirichlet allocation (LDA) to investigate how the digital dampening of Tencent apps influences their presence on Google Play, a foreign app market. The findings indicate that the digital dampening of Tencent apps is negatively associated with their presence on Google Play, particularly for apps that face weaker downloads compared to their rivals. Supplementary analyses shed light on post-internationalization metrics on Google Play and vendor-level extensive and intensive margins of internationalization. Further tests rule out plausible alternative explanations and verify sensitivity for GenAI usage. Overall, the study presents an alternative to the prevailing view of born-digital firms as inherently global, emphasizing that non-digital complementarities in the business model can hinder internationalization, particularly in those firms facing a weak domestic competitive position.
papers.abstract_zh: 为考察数字企业国际化的异质性，我们引入“数字抑制”这一概念，它指的是非数字要素被整合进数字企业的程度。我们认为，数字抑制会阻碍国际化。我们围绕中国智能手机应用的国际多归属（multihoming）提出可检验的假设，并分析了腾讯应用市场上来自25,233家中国厂商的33,878款智能手机应用的丰富数据。我们的方法将生成式人工智能（GenAI）与潜在狄利克雷分配（LDA）相结合，以考察腾讯应用的数字抑制如何影响其在国外应用市场Google Play上的存在。研究结果表明，腾讯应用的数字抑制与其在Google Play上的存在呈负相关，对于下载量相较竞争对手更弱的应用而言尤其如此。补充分析揭示了Google Play上的国际化后指标以及厂商层面国际化的广延边际和集约边际。进一步的检验排除了可能的替代解释，并验证了GenAI使用的敏感性。总体而言，本研究为将天生数字化企业视为天然全球化的主流观点提供了一种替代解释，强调商业模式中的非数字互补性可能阻碍国际化，尤其是在那些国内竞争地位较弱的企业中。

papers.abstract_original: The intensifying rivalry between major global economies highlights the need to better understand the politicized nature of international business. This study introduces a new political factor—community political ideology (i.e., the dominant political ideology along the liberalism-conservatism spectrum among a community’s members)—and examines its influences on cross-border M&As between countries that are deemed as economic and political rivals. Building on the literature on political ideology and cross-border M&A, we argue that conservative communities tend to perceive greater threats and uncertainty posed by cross-border M&As from rival countries and therefore exert stronger resistance to these deals. Using Chinese cross-border M&As in the U.S. as a research context, we predict that these M&As are less likely to be completed in U.S. communities with a higher proportion of conservative residents. Moreover, the negative effect of community conservatism on the completion of Chinese M&A deals in the U.S. is further enhanced when the target firms are in sensitive industries or when the target communities suffer from greater economic distress. An analysis of 267 Chinese cross-border M&As in the U.S. from 2002 to 2021 supports these arguments. Our study contributes to research on geopolitical rivalry, political ideology, and cross-border M&As.
papers.abstract_zh: 全球主要经济体之间日益加剧的竞争凸显出更好地理解国际商业政治化本质的必要性。本研究引入了一个新的政治因素——社区政治意识形态（即社区成员中在自由主义—保守主义光谱上占主导地位的政治意识形态）——并考察其对被视为经济和政治竞争对手的国家之间跨境并购的影响。基于关于政治意识形态和跨境并购的文献，我们认为，保守的社区倾向于感知到来自竞争对手国家的跨境并购所带来的更大威胁和不确定性，因此对这些交易施加更强的抵制。以中国在美国的跨境并购为研究情境，我们预测，这些并购在美国保守居民比例较高的社区中完成的可能性较低。此外，当目标企业处于敏感行业，或目标社区遭受更大的经济困境时，社区保守主义对中国在美国的并购交易完成的负面影响会进一步增强。对2002年至2021年间267起中国在美国的跨境并购的分析支持了这些论点。我们的研究对地缘政治竞争、政治意识形态和跨境并购的研究作出了贡献。

papers.abstract_original: Even as data privacy regulations expand globally, their strategic implications for international business remain underexplored. Prior research mostly treats data privacy regulation as a compliance issue, overlooking how firms strategically manage cross-border variations and respond to stakeholder pressures. Drawing on institutional economics and stakeholder theory, this article conceptualizes two trade-offs generated by data privacy regulations: (1) a regulatory, cost–benefit trade-off between privacy compliance costs and customer privacy empowerment and (2) a firm performance, temporal trade-off in which early compliance costs undermine short-term outcomes, before longer-term, trust-based benefits emerge. An international event study of ten regulations across 24 countries affirms that data privacy regulations impose short-term financial setbacks but generate long-term gains. These effects vary across contexts: At regulation, industry, and firm levels, conditions in which internal pressures to minimize risk dominate (intense privacy regulation, strong data dependence, limited resources) intensify early losses. At national levels, environments dominated by external pressures for credible compliance (high formal and informal institutional effectiveness) offset short-term losses and magnify long-term benefits. For international business theory, this study reframes data privacy regulation as a strategic opportunity and highlights how internal versus external legitimacy pressures shape trade-offs that firms must balance to navigate cross-border compliance demands.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管数据隐私法规在全球范围内不断扩展，但其对国际企业的战略意义仍未被充分探讨。既有研究大多将数据隐私法规视为合规问题，忽视了企业如何战略性地应对跨境差异并回应利益相关者压力。本文借鉴制度经济学与利益相关者理论，将数据隐私法规所产生的权衡概念化为两类：（1）监管层面的成本—收益权衡，即在隐私合规成本与客户隐私赋权之间的权衡；（2）企业绩效层面的时间性权衡，即早期合规成本会损害短期结果，随后才出现基于信任的长期收益。一项涵盖24个国家十项法规的国际事件研究证实，数据隐私法规会带来短期财务损失，但会产生长期收益。这些效应因情境而异：在监管、行业和企业层面，当最小化风险的内部压力占主导时（隐私监管严格、数据依赖性强、资源有限），早期损失会加剧。在国家层面，当可信合规的外部压力占主导的环境（正式与非正式制度有效性高）会抵消短期损失并放大长期收益。就国际企业理论而言，本研究将数据隐私法规重新界定为一种战略机遇，并强调内部与外部合法性压力如何塑造企业为应对跨境合规要求而必须加以平衡的权衡。

papers.abstract_original: We examine the role of cybercrime legislation globally in shaping the stability of the banking system. We compile a novel dataset covering the enactment of cybercrime legislation in 132 developed and developing countries to test this research question empirically. We find that the enactment of cybercrime laws enhances the stability of the banking sector. This key finding holds across a comprehensive suite of robustness tests, including alternative measures of bank stability and model specifications. We document significant cross-sectional heterogeneity, with the effect being more pronounced in countries with heavier penalties for illegal cyber activities and legal frameworks that hold banks accountable for their cybersecurity practices. Moreover, the positive impact is stronger in jurisdictions with greater international legal cooperation and effective enforcement mechanisms. We further investigate two channels (i.e., funding liquidity and operational risk) through which cybercrime laws may influence bank stability. Our results indicate that these laws can significantly bolster bank stability by enhancing funding liquidity and mitigating operational risk. Overall, our study provides evidence of the crucial role of cybercrime legislation in fostering a secure and resilient banking environment. It offers new insights into how these laws contribute to bank stability on both individual and systemic levels.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们考察了全球网络犯罪立法在塑造银行体系稳定性方面的作用。我们编制了一个涵盖132个发达国家和发展中国家网络犯罪立法颁布情况的新数据集，以实证检验这一研究问题。我们发现，网络犯罪法律的颁布增强了银行部门的稳定性。这一关键发现在一系列全面的稳健性检验中均成立，包括银行稳定性的替代衡量指标和模型设定。我们记录了显著的横截面异质性，在非法网络活动处罚更重、且法律框架要求银行对其网络安全实践负责的国家，这一效应更为明显。此外，在国际法律合作更紧密、执法机制更有效的司法管辖区，这一正向影响更强。我们进一步考察了网络犯罪法律可能影响银行稳定性的两个渠道（即融资流动性和操作风险）。我们的结果表明，这些法律可以通过增强融资流动性和降低操作风险，显著增强银行稳定性。总体而言，我们的研究提供了网络犯罪立法在促进安全且有韧性的银行环境方面发挥关键作用的证据。它为这些法律如何在个体和系统层面促进银行稳定性提供了新的见解。

papers.abstract_original: Organizations—especially multinational corporations (MNCs)—do not always realize comparable performance gains from investing in people across national borders. Prior research has attempted to explain such variation in the effects of high-investment human resource practices (HIHRPs) by emphasizing their fit with national cultural values, yet empirical support for this cultural fit perspective has been limited. To address this gap, we focus on national institutional factors that more directly shape how HIHRPs influence performance. Drawing on human capital resources (HCR) theory and institutional perspectives in International Business (IB), we identify two institutional conditions—national education quality and labor market flexibility—that moderate HIHRP effectiveness. We theorize that high-quality education systems enhance the HIHRPs–performance relationship by supplying workers with strong general human capital and that this effect is amplified in flexible labor markets where employees are motivated to contribute. A meta-analysis of 1,285 effect sizes from 170,938 organizations across 29 countries offers nuanced evidence: HIHRPs were more effective when national education quality and labor market flexibility were both high or both low than when they were mismatched. These findings advance comparative and strategic HRM research and guide organizations about how comprehensively or selectively to invest in managing people in what institutional contexts.
papers.abstract_zh: 组织——尤其是跨国公司（MNCs）——并不总能从跨国界的人员投资中获得可比拟的绩效收益。既有研究试图通过强调高投入人力资源实践（HIHRPs）与国家文化价值观的契合来解释此类效应差异，但支持这一文化契合视角的实证证据一直有限。为弥补这一空白，我们聚焦于更直接塑造HIHRPs如何影响绩效的国家制度因素。借鉴人力资本资源（HCR）理论与国际商务（IB）中的制度视角，我们识别出两种调节HIHRP有效性的制度条件——国家教育质量与劳动力市场灵活性。我们提出理论：高质量的教育体系通过为劳动者提供较强的通用人力资本来增强HIHRPs与绩效之间的关系，且这一效应在员工有动力做出贡献的灵活劳动力市场中被放大。对来自29个国家、170,938个组织的1,285个效应量进行的元分析提供了细致入微的证据：当国家教育质量和劳动力市场灵活性二者均高或二者均低时，HIHRPs比二者不匹配时更为有效。这些发现推进了比较人力资源管理与战略人力资源管理研究，并指导组织在何种制度情境下应全面或选择性地投资于人员管理。

papers.abstract_original: Concerns have been raised about the use of single host- or home-country samples in analyzing the effects of cultural distance (CD). That is, the estimated effects of CD may be confounded with those of the underlying cultural dimensions or other contextual factors correlated with CD. This study reassesses the risk of confounding when using single-country samples through simulation analyses conducted under various conditions, including different sample sizes and structures, within- and between-country variances, and analysis methods. The results indicate that when other cultural or contextual variables related to the outcome are also included and multilevel modeling is applied, the risk of confounding is not significant across diverse settings. The problem of confounding becomes significant only when using ordinary least squares, which does not take into account the potential nonindependence of observations in hierarchical data. However, in multilevel analyses using single-country samples, statistical power may become insufficient when controlling for cultural variables correlated with CD, particularly when the effect size of CD is small. To address this issue, we present a statistical technique that researchers can use to identify potential confounders and provide guidelines on the sample size required to maintain adequate power.
papers.abstract_zh: 有人对在分析文化距离（CD）效应时使用单一东道国或母国样本提出了担忧。也就是说，CD的估计效应可能与潜在文化维度或与CD相关的其他情境因素的效应相混淆。本研究通过在多种条件下进行的模拟分析，重新评估了使用单一国家样本时的混淆风险，这些条件包括不同的样本量和结构、国家内和国家间方差以及分析方法。结果表明，当同时纳入与结果相关的其他文化或情境变量并采用多层建模时，在各种不同情境下混淆风险都不显著。只有当使用普通最小二乘法时，混淆问题才变得显著，因为普通最小二乘法没有考虑层级数据中观测值潜在的非独立性。然而，在使用单一国家样本进行多层分析时，当控制与CD相关的文化变量时，统计功效可能变得不足，尤其是当CD的效应量较小时。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种统计技术，研究者可用其识别潜在的混淆变量，并就维持足够功效所需的样本量提供了指导。

papers.abstract_original: Income inequality is a worldwide phenomenon that increasingly concerns scholars, policy-makers, business leaders, and ordinary citizens. Building on research emphasizing the role of firms in shaping societal outcomes, this study investigates how organizational pay structures—specifically the chief executive officer (CEO)-to-employee pay ratios—relate to societal-level income inequality and citizens’ subjective well-being. Using a 15-year panel dataset of 53 countries, we find that higher CEO-to-employee pay ratios are significantly associated with next-year increases in societal-level income inequality. Drawing on social justice theory, we also show that CEO-to-employee pay ratios are negatively related to citizens’ subjective well-being one year later, above and beyond the effects of societal-level income inequality and other national conditions. We further found that this negative association is more pronounced in countries with a stronger welfare state. Together, these findings advance research on inequality, well-being, and international business by showing how firm-level compensation structures shape broader societal outcomes. These findings also offer actionable implications for corporate leaders and policy-makers seeking to understand how corporate pay structure extends beyond organizations to affect societal economic inequality and citizens’ well-being.
papers.abstract_zh: 收入不平等是一种全球性现象，日益受到学者、政策制定者、企业领导者和普通公民的关注。本研究基于强调企业在塑造社会结果中作用的研究，考察组织薪酬结构——具体而言即首席执行官（CEO）与员工的薪酬比率——如何与社会层面收入不平等和公民主观幸福感相关联。我们使用涵盖53个国家、为期15年的面板数据集发现，较高的CEO与员工薪酬比率与社会层面收入不平等的次年上升显著相关。基于社会正义理论，我们还表明，CEO与员工薪酬比率与一年后公民主观幸福感呈负相关，且这一关系超出了社会层面收入不平等和其他国家状况的影响。我们进一步发现，这种负相关在福利国家更强的国家中更为明显。总之，这些发现通过表明企业层面薪酬结构如何塑造更广泛的社会结果，推进了关于不平等、幸福感和国际商务的研究。这些发现也为试图理解企业薪酬结构如何超越组织范围、影响社会经济不平等和公民幸福感的企业领导者和政策制定者提供了可操作的启示。

papers.abstract_original: Why do some multinational enterprises (MNEs) persist with non-equity foreign operating modes despite transaction cost concerns? Building on an inductive multiple case study of nine Indian firms operating across 62 emerging markets, we theorize “high involvement–low investment” as a distinct foreign entry and operating mode, where MNE managers augment foreign partners’ operations—through co-selling, marketing, capability building, and end-user services—without equity-based governance control. High involvement fosters partners’ trust in MNEs, enabling the bundling of MNEs’ consultative selling skills with partners’ relational networks. While subsequent market expansion moves, such as adding new partners, risk eroding existing partners’ trust, consistent relational engagement through transparency, long-term orientation, and empathy preserves trust and sustains partnerships, enabling the persistence of a high-involvement, low-investment mode. Counterintuitive to transaction cost economics logic, our model explains how high involvement in both pre- and post-entry stages, together with the sustained use of relational assets, enables a persistent non-equity pathway for internationalization. We contribute to entry and operating mode research by identifying people-centric involvement as a dimension of foreign market commitment, alongside capital-centric investment. Further, we extend the asset-bundling view by highlighting managerial involvement as a mechanism for cross-border interorganizational trust and the bundling of intangible assets.
papers.abstract_zh: 为何一些跨国企业（MNEs）在存在交易成本顾虑的情况下，仍坚持采用非股权型海外经营模式？基于对九家印度企业横跨62个新兴市场运营的归纳性多案例研究，我们将“高参与—低投资”理论化为一种独特的海外进入与经营模式，即跨国企业管理者通过联合销售、市场营销、能力建设和终端用户服务来增强海外合作伙伴的运营，而不依赖基于股权的治理控制。高参与度培育了合作伙伴对跨国企业的信任，使跨国企业的顾问式销售技能与合作伙伴的关系网络得以捆绑。尽管后续的市场扩张举措（如增加新合作伙伴）可能侵蚀现有合作伙伴的信任，但通过透明度、长期导向和同理心所维持的持续关系互动，能够保持信任并维系伙伴关系，从而使高参与、低投资模式得以持续。与交易成本经济学逻辑相悖，我们的模型解释了进入前和进入后阶段的高参与度，连同关系资产的持续运用，如何为国际化开辟一条持久的非股权路径。我们通过识别以人为本的参与作为海外市场承诺的一个维度（与以资本为中心的投资并列），为进入与经营模式研究作出贡献。此外，我们通过强调管理者参与作为跨境组织间信任和无形资产捆绑的机制，拓展了资产捆绑观。

papers.abstract_original: In a global economy prone to demand shocks, firms increasingly rely on implicit contracts to stabilize employment. We investigate whether financial statement comparability strengthens these contracts by enabling employees to benchmark their firm’s performance against that of peers, facilitating mutual risk sharing. Using firm-level data from 44 countries, we find that higher comparability reduces layoffs during downturns and tempers aggressive hiring during upturns, consistent with balanced labor adjustment under implicit contracting. Employees at high-comparability firms are also more willing to accept lower wages without compromising productivity, reflecting enhanced trust and cooperation. Further analyses suggest that comparability improves employees’ ability to monitor firm behavior, particularly when social safety nets are strong, earnings are transparent, industries are competitive, and firms deviate from peer norms. Exploiting the mandatory adoption of International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as an exogenous shock to comparability supports causal inference. Overall, our findings highlight comparability as a powerful governance mechanism that aligns firm–employee incentives in implicit employment contracts and offers practical guidance for managers and policymakers seeking to strengthen labor market resilience across diverse institutional contexts.
papers.abstract_zh: 在一个易受需求冲击影响的全球经济中，企业日益依赖隐性契约来稳定就业。我们研究财务报表可比性是否通过使员工能够将本企业绩效与同行企业绩效进行基准比较、促进相互风险分担，从而强化这些契约。利用来自44个国家的企业层面数据，我们发现，较高的可比性会减少经济下行期间的裁员，并抑制经济上行期间的激进招聘，这与隐性契约下均衡的劳动力调整相一致。高可比性企业的员工也更愿意接受较低的工资而不损害生产率，这反映出信任与合作的增强。进一步分析表明，可比性提高了员工监督企业行为的能力，尤其是在社会安全网较强、盈余透明、行业竞争激烈以及企业偏离同行规范时。利用强制采用国际财务报告准则（IFRS）作为可比性的外生冲击，支持了因果推断。总体而言，我们的发现凸显了可比性作为一种强有力的治理机制，能够在隐性雇佣契约中使企业—员工激励保持一致，并为寻求在多样制度情境下增强劳动力市场韧性的管理者和政策制定者提供了实践指导。

papers.abstract_original: This study examines why and how multinational corporations (MNCs) may see their local assets transferred to or absorbed by their host-country partners. Drawing on transaction cost economics, we argue that factors beyond the traditional ones proposed by international business research—e.g., entry mode, country risk, or elite ties—can help explain this indigenization of MNC subsidiaries. Using a comparative historical analysis of French and US MNCs operating in Spain from the 1870s to 1959 and an in-depth analysis of the French Banque de Paris et des Pay-Bas (Paribas) and US International Telephone & Telegraph (ITT), we examine why similar investment strategies and partnerships with the local elite led to divergent outcomes under increasing political instability and economic nationalism in Spain. French subsidiaries became more likely than their US counterparts to be indigenized by local partners, due to their operations in maturing sectors and the local partners’ growing ability to substitute foreign capabilities, shifting asset complementarities. Our findings advance the international business literature by conceptualizing indigenization as a distinct mechanism through which an MNC may see its assets expropriated by its local partners, often via strategic and discretionary transfer shaped by shifting complementarities, maturing industries, and persistent relational ties.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究考察跨国公司为何以及如何可能将其当地资产转移给或被其东道国合作伙伴吸收。基于交易成本经济学，我们认为，国际商务研究提出的传统因素——例如进入模式、国家风险或精英关系——之外的因素，有助于解释跨国公司子公司的这种本土化。通过对1870年代至1959年在西班牙运营的法国和美国跨国公司进行比较历史分析，并对法国巴黎荷兰银行（Paribas）和美国国际电话电报公司（ITT）进行深入分析，我们考察了为何相似的投资战略和与当地精英的合作伙伴关系，在西班牙日益加剧的政治不稳定和经济民族主义下，导致了不同的结果。法国子公司比其美国同行更有可能被当地合作伙伴本土化，原因在于它们经营于成熟产业，以及当地合作伙伴替代外国能力的能力不断增强，从而改变了资产互补性。我们的发现推进了国际商务文献，将本土化概念化为一种独特机制，通过该机制，跨国公司可能看到其资产被其当地合作伙伴征用，通常是通过由不断变化的互补性、成熟产业和持久关系纽带所塑造的战略性和自由裁量的转移。

papers.abstract_original: We examine whether and how the US Foreign Corrupt Practices Act (FCPA) drives intra-industry information spillovers that propagate cross-border institutional spillovers in China. Regulatory disclosures of FCPA enforcement actions against US firms can influence non-violating Chinese firms in the same industry through either (1) contagion risk arising from increased anti-corruption scrutiny in China or (2) competitive advantage due to reduced competition from US counterparts. Consistent with the contagion risk (competitive advantage) effect, we provide evidence over the 2011–2023 sample period that Securities and Exchange Commission disclosures of China-related (non-China-related) FCPA violations by US peer firms generate valuation discounts (premiums) among non-violating Chinese focal firms that are more likely to be suspected of corruption. Further analyses reveal subsequent decreases (increases) in profitability and suspected corruption spending among these Chinese firms. Our findings suggest that FCPA-related regulatory disclosures play an information subsidy role given the lack of transparency regarding corruption activities and serve as a form of institutional subsidy that promotes monitoring against such practices in weaker regulatory environments. While the pros and cons of the FCPA for US firms remain debatable, our study implies that international coordination and collaboration in anti-corruption enforcement should be strengthened to curb bribery in international business.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们考察美国《反海外腐败法》（FCPA）是否以及如何驱动行业内信息溢出，从而在中国传播跨境制度溢出。针对美国企业的FCPA执法行动的监管披露，可能通过以下两种途径影响同行业中未违规的中国企业：（1）因中国加大反腐败审查力度而产生的传染风险，或（2）因美国同行竞争减少而带来的竞争优势。与传染风险（竞争优势）效应相一致，我们在2011—2023年样本期内提供证据表明，美国同行企业涉华（非涉华）FCPA违规行为的美国证券交易委员会披露，会使更有可能被怀疑存在腐败的未违规中国焦点企业出现估值折价（溢价）。进一步分析揭示，这些中国企业的盈利能力及疑似腐败支出随后出现下降（上升）。我们的发现表明，鉴于腐败活动缺乏透明度，与FCPA相关的监管披露发挥了信息补贴的作用，并构成一种制度补贴，在监管较弱的环境中促进对此类行为的监督。尽管FCPA对美国企业的利弊仍存争议，我们的研究表明，应加强反腐败执法中的国际协调与合作，以遏制国际商务中的贿赂行为。

papers.abstract_original: This paper examines how regulations mandating environmental, social, and governance (ESG) disclosure affect corporate tax behavior. Using a difference-in-differences analysis on a sample of firms from 48 countries, we find that ESG disclosure mandates lead to significant reductions in tax avoidance, with stronger effects for mandates that include tax-relevant provisions. We identify increases in ESG information transparency and improvements in firms’ ESG performance as channels through which ESG disclosure mandates reduce tax avoidance. We further find that the decrease in tax avoidance following ESG disclosure mandates is more pronounced in countries with weaker financial disclosure requirements, legal and tax enforcement, and environmental and social institutions. Collectively, the evidence suggests that non-financial disclosure regulations can curb aggressive tax behavior, supporting broader goals of corporate accountability and sustainable development.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文考察强制要求披露环境、社会和治理（ESG）信息的法规如何影响企业税收行为。通过对来自48个国家的企业样本进行双重差分分析，我们发现ESG披露强制要求导致避税显著减少，且对于包含税收相关条款的强制要求，效应更强。我们识别出ESG信息透明度的提高和企业ESG绩效的改善是ESG披露强制要求减少避税的渠道。我们进一步发现，在财务披露要求、法律和税收执法以及环境和社会制度较弱的国家，ESG披露强制要求之后避税的减少更为明显。总体而言，这些证据表明，非财务披露法规可以抑制激进的税收行为，支持企业问责和可持续发展等更广泛目标。

papers.abstract_original: We advance the application of the behavioral theory of the firm (BTOF) in the international context by developing and validating a foreignness-based social comparison framework. Moving beyond industry-based social comparison, our novel framework highlights foreignness as a basis for foreign firms’ identification of social reference groups during international operation. We argue that foreignness is a multi-layered social construct, including an undifferentiated layer shared by all foreign firms in host countries, and a differentiated layer associated with their countries of origin. We theorize that foreign firms simultaneously benchmark two reference groups (i.e., foreign peers and home-country peers) for performance diagnosis that leads to strategic changes. Moreover, host-country institutional conditions moderate these social comparison effects by shifting foreign firms’ attention allocation between the two groups. When these conditions alter the liabilities and benefits associated with foreignness, the salience of undifferentiated foreignness changes relative to that of differentiated foreignness, resulting in managerial attention shift between foreign-peer-based and home-country-peer-based social comparison. Through an analysis of strategic changes among a panel of foreign firms operating in China, our empirical findings support the foreignness-based social comparison framework by elucidating the simultaneous effects of dual social comparisons and the attention shifts between them.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们通过构建并验证一个基于外来者身份的社会比较框架，推进了企业行为理论（BTOF）在国际情境中的应用。超越基于行业的社会比较，我们的新框架强调外来者身份是外国企业在国际经营中识别社会参照群体的一个基础。我们认为，外来者身份是一种多层次的社会建构，既包括东道国所有外国企业共享的未分化层次，也包括与其来源国相关的分化层次。我们提出理论认为，外国企业同时以两个参照群体（即外国同行与母国同行）为基准进行绩效诊断，进而导致战略变革。此外，东道国制度条件通过改变外国企业在两个群体之间的注意力配置，调节这些社会比较效应。当这些条件改变与外来者身份相关的负担与收益时，未分化外来者身份的显著性相对于分化外来者身份的显著性发生变化，导致管理者在基于外国同行的社会比较与基于母国同行的社会比较之间发生注意力转移。通过分析一组在中国经营的外国企业面板中的战略变革，我们的实证发现通过阐明双重社会比较的同时效应及其之间的注意力转移，支持了基于外来者身份的社会比较框架。

papers.abstract_original: Grand Challenges are complex problems that transcend national borders and affect future generations and, as a result, have traditionally been viewed as the responsibility of governments. Building on economic theories of market imperfections, we introduce a three-pronged framework to explain how multinationals contribute solutions to Grand Challenges. First, we clarify multinationals’ solutions by classifying them by their sustainability dimensions and associated market imperfections: solutions to environmental Grand Challenges arising from negative externalities and the overexploitation of common goods; solutions to social Grand Challenges resulting from unrealized positive externalities and underinvestment in public goods; and solutions to governance Grand Challenges stemming from information imperfections and abuses of market power. Second, we contextualize the global implementation of these solutions within the two drivers of globalization (technological and institutional changes) and explain their supporting and constraining effects: technological advances enable cross-border development and coordination, but technological inertia and lock-in produce suboptimal outcomes; pro-market reforms facilitate cross-border diffusion, but pro-market reversals limit global knowledge transfer. Third, we explain how intersectoral collaboration and financing are supplementary drivers enabling the scaling of multinationals’ solutions across countries. Overall, our framework resolves the paradox that multinationals can help solve, rather than exploit, market failures.
papers.abstract_zh: 重大挑战是超越国界并影响子孙后代的复杂问题，因此传统上被视为政府的责任。基于市场不完善的经济理论，我们引入一个三管齐下的框架来解释跨国公司如何为重大挑战贡献解决方案。第一，我们通过按可持续性维度及相关市场不完善对跨国公司的解决方案进行分类来加以阐明：针对由负外部性和公共物品过度开发所引发的环境重大挑战的解决方案；针对由未实现的正外部性和公共物品投资不足所导致的社会重大挑战的解决方案；以及针对源于信息不完善和市场权力滥用的治理重大挑战的解决方案。第二，我们将这些解决方案的全球实施置于全球化的两大驱动因素（技术变革和制度变革）之中，并解释其支持性和约束性效应：技术进步使跨境开发与协调成为可能，但技术惯性和锁定会产生次优结果；亲市场改革促进跨境扩散，但亲市场逆转限制了全球知识转移。第三，我们解释跨部门合作与融资如何作为补充驱动因素，使跨国公司的解决方案能够在各国推广。总体而言，我们的框架化解了跨国公司能够帮助解决而非利用市场失灵这一悖论。

papers.abstract_original: This paper explores the complex interplay between political systems, foreign direct investment (FDI), and income inequality. Building on Acemoglu and Robinson’s Nobel Prize-winning work on institutions, we develop a framework to analyze governments’ political incentives to attract FDI. We argue that highly entrenched autocracies, facing little internal competition for rents, and democracies with strong political competition, eager to secure growth for electoral advantage, exhibit strong incentives to attract FDI. In contrast, weaker autocracies with internal competition for rents and entrenched democracies, where rulers face less pressure to deliver growth, have lower incentives to do so. Rising inequality introduces an additional layer of complexity: while democracies may encounter public resistance to FDI when its benefits are perceived as unevenly distributed, autocracies remain less constrained by public opinion. We analyze data from 144 countries spanning 1990–2018, assessing how political incentives shape FDI inflows and their subsequent impact on economic growth. Our findings suggest that in democracies, robust political competition underpins a country’s incentive to remain attractive to investors, while autocracies require regulatory stability and credible long-term commitments to achieve this outcome. Ultimately, our research underscores a paradox—democratic freedoms, though vital, may at times hinder economic competitiveness relative to autocratic regimes.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了政治制度、外商直接投资（FDI）与收入不平等之间复杂的相互作用。在阿西莫格鲁和罗宾逊关于制度的诺贝尔奖获奖研究基础上，我们构建了一个框架，用以分析政府吸引FDI的政治激励。我们认为，高度稳固的专制政体因内部对租金的竞争甚少，而政治竞争激烈的民主政体则急于确保增长以获取选举优势，二者都表现出吸引FDI的强烈激励。相比之下，内部存在租金竞争的较弱专制政体，以及统治者面临较小增长压力的稳固民主政体，吸引FDI的激励较低。不断加剧的不平等带来了额外的复杂性：当FDI的收益被认为分配不均时，民主政体可能遭遇公众对FDI的抵制，而专制政体则较少受到公众舆论的约束。我们分析了1990年至2018年间144个国家的数据，评估政治激励如何塑造FDI流入及其随后对经济增长的影响。我们的研究结果表明，在民主政体中，强有力的政治竞争支撑着一国保持对投资者吸引力的激励，而专制政体则需要监管稳定性和可信的长期承诺才能实现这一结果。最终，我们的研究凸显了一个悖论——民主自由虽然至关重要，但有时可能相对于专制政体削弱经济竞争力。

papers.abstract_original: We examine whether and how impact investment—investing to secure both financial and social returns—is associated with formalization at founding. While impact investing has increasingly been promoted as a tool to support economic development, evidence on its relationship with patterns of formal firm entry in the Global South remains limited. This is important because while informality provides important livelihoods, widespread informal activity constrains growth, limits employment quality, and weakens public revenue generation, thereby hindering broader economic development. Building on the external enabler framework, we theorize that impact investment increases the likelihood that new firms register formally at inception. This relationship operates through two pathways: directly, by improving access to resources and enhancing the viability and legitimacy of formal operations; indirectly, by reducing corruption. Analyzing a novel, comprehensive dataset of impact investments in 86 countries, we find support for our hypotheses. These effects are particularly strong in lower-middle-income countries, illustrating the varying effects of impact investment. By providing large-scale, cross-country evidence on how impact investors affect new-firm formalization, we advance work on firm formalization and external enablement.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们考察影响力投资——即为同时获取财务回报和社会回报而进行的投资——是否以及如何与创业时的正规化相关联。尽管影响力投资日益被推崇为支持经济发展的工具，但关于其与全球南方正规企业进入模式之间关系的证据仍然有限。这一点很重要，因为尽管非正规性提供了重要的生计来源，但广泛存在的非正规活动制约了增长、限制了就业质量、削弱了公共收入创造，从而阻碍了更广泛的经济发展。基于外部推动因素框架，我们提出理论认为，影响力投资提高了新企业在成立时正式注册的可能性。这一关系通过两条路径发挥作用：直接路径，即通过改善资源获取并增强正规经营的可行性和合法性；间接路径，即通过减少腐败。通过分析一个涵盖86个国家影响力投资的新颖且全面的数据集，我们的假设得到了支持。这些效应在下中等收入国家尤为显著，说明影响力投资的效果存在差异。通过提供关于影响力投资者如何影响新企业正规化的大规模跨国证据，我们推进了关于企业正规化和外部推动的研究。

papers.abstract_original: Country-level influences matter for CSR performance. While prior studies have uncovered what individual country-level variables predict firms’ CSR performance, we know little about how much of the variance in CSR performance is explained by systematic influences at the country level. We conduct an abductive variance decomposition study to estimate the proportion of CSR variance explained at the country level, relative to the firm, industry, and regional levels, and how cultural environments in the form of collectivism alter the relative importance of country-level influences. A panel covering 21,766 observations from 2324 firms across 59 countries between 2003 and 2022 reveals that country effects explain about 10% of CSR performance variation across firms, exceeding the explanatory power of industry and regional effects. Country effects are stronger in cultural environments characterized by low institutional collectivism and high in-group collectivism.
papers.abstract_zh: 国家层面的影响对企业社会责任（CSR）绩效具有重要作用。尽管既有研究已揭示哪些单个国家层面的变量能够预测企业的CSR绩效，但我们对CSR绩效的方差中有多大比例可由国家层面的系统性影响所解释仍知之甚少。我们开展了一项溯因性方差分解研究，以估计相对于企业、行业和地区层面而言，国家层面所解释的CSR方差比例，以及以集体主义形式表现的文化环境如何改变国家层面影响的相对重要性。一个涵盖2003年至2022年间59个国家2324家企业共21766个观测值的面板数据表明，国家效应解释了企业间CSR绩效变异的约10%，超过了行业效应和地区效应的解释力。在以低制度集体主义和高内群体集体主义为特征的文化环境中，国家效应更强。

papers.abstract_original: Limited evidence exists on the real effects of bond market liberalization, particularly on corporate investment behavior. This study examines the impact of bond market liberalization on corporate investment, exploiting the 2017 launch of China’s Bond Connect—which allows foreign investors to directly participate in the interbank bond market—as a quasi-natural experiment that increases firms’ exposure to foreign debtholders. Using a difference-in-differences design, we find that bond market liberalization constrains corporate investment. Channel analyses reveal that this effect operates through tighter bond covenants, higher reputation costs, and increased litigation risk imposed by foreign bondholders. Consistent with a governance-based interpretation, the investment-reducing effect is more pronounced among firms with weaker governance structures, including fewer independent directors and less effective internal control systems. Importantly, the decline in investment is concentrated in overinvestment rather than value-enhancing projects, indicating that foreign bondholders discipline managerial empire-building without inducing excessive conservatism. Correspondingly, firms experience lower default risk, reduced credit spreads, and higher firm value following liberalization. Overall, our findings highlight the distinct, non–ownership-based governance role of foreign debtholders and suggest that bond market liberalization can foster efficiency and financial stability in emerging markets characterized by relatively weak domestic institutions.
papers.abstract_zh: 关于债券市场自由化的实际效应，尤其是对企业投资行为的影响，现有证据有限。本研究考察债券市场自由化对企业投资的影响，利用2017年中国推出“债券通”——允许外国投资者直接参与银行间债券市场——作为一项准自然实验，该实验增加了企业对外国债权人的敞口。采用双重差分设计，我们发现债券市场自由化抑制了企业投资。渠道分析表明，这一效应通过外国债权人施加的更严格的债券契约、更高的声誉成本以及增加的诉讼风险发挥作用。与基于治理的解释相一致，这种减少投资的效应在治理结构较弱的企业中更为明显，包括独立董事较少和内部控制体系效率较低的企业。重要的是，投资的下降集中在过度投资而非价值增值项目上，这表明外国债权人约束了管理层的帝国构建行为，而没有引发过度保守主义。相应地，自由化之后，企业的违约风险降低、信用利差收窄、企业价值提高。总体而言，我们的发现凸显了外国债权人独特的、非基于所有权的治理作用，并表明债券市场自由化可以在国内制度相对薄弱的新兴市场中促进效率和金融稳定。

papers.abstract_original: While tax haven use by multinational enterprises (MNEs) has been associated with significant societal harm, studies have theorized a limited relationship between tax haven use and corporate reputation. This is surprising, given the wealth of evidence illustrating how corporate reputations are frequently undermined by socially harmful activity. To advance our understanding, this study investigates the underexplored heterogeneity associated with tax havens—specifically their location characteristics. Drawing on attribution theory and the country reputation perspective, we theorize and explain how MNE presence in tax havens—of different sizes and country-specific reputations—shapes stakeholder perception, thereby differentially undermining corporate reputations. The results of our longitudinal (2010–2023), firm fixed-effects analysis, involving 559 MNEs, illustrate how MNE engagement with small tax haven economies, as well as locations with adverse country reputations, undermines corporate reputations. Moreover, we demonstrate how MNE engagement with corrupt nation-states can, at times, strengthen the reputational implications of tax haven use. Overall, our research highlights how the risks associated with tax haven use may be greater for some tax haven locations than others. Among our principal contributions, this study advances our understanding of the relationship between tax haven use and corporate reputation.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管跨国企业（MNE）使用避税天堂已被认为会带来重大的社会危害，但已有研究在理论上认为避税天堂使用与企业声誉之间的关系有限。鉴于大量证据表明企业声誉常常因社会有害活动而受损，这一结论令人意外。为推进我们的理解，本研究考察了与避税天堂相关的、尚未得到充分探讨的异质性——具体而言是其区位特征。我们借鉴归因理论和国家声誉视角，从理论上解释并说明跨国企业在不同规模和具有不同国家特定声誉的避税天堂中的存在如何塑造利益相关者感知，从而以不同方式损害企业声誉。我们的纵向（2010—2023年）、企业固定效应分析涉及559家跨国企业，其结果说明跨国企业涉足小型避税天堂经济体以及国家声誉不佳的区位会损害企业声誉。此外，我们还表明，跨国企业涉足腐败的民族国家有时会强化避税天堂使用所带来的声誉影响。总体而言，我们的研究强调，避税天堂使用所带来的风险在某些避税天堂区位可能大于其他区位。在我们的主要贡献中，本研究推进了我们对避税天堂使用与企业声誉之间关系的理解。

papers.abstract_original: Grounded in realism, geopolitical techno-nationalism advocates restricting technology outflows to targeted entities from rival countries to safeguard national security and technological superiority. We examine this logic in international standard-setting organizations (ISSOs), which exemplify decentralized innovation ecosystems that shape future-generation technologies. We identify a paradox: techno-nationalist restrictions would unintentionally undermine, rather than strengthen home-country firms’ influence over international standards relative to targeted foreign firms. This paradox emerges because techno-nationalist logic clashes with two defining features of decentralized innovation ecosystems: (1) multilateral complementarity, where complementary knowledge needed to co-create value is widely distributed among firms, and (2) emergent technological evolution, where multiple potential trajectories exist and the eventual technological path is socially constructed. Both features make interaction and coordination between firms in ISSOs essential for influencing standards, yet technology disclosure restrictions directly disrupt these processes. The backfiring effect intensifies when home firms exhibit deep technological complementarity with targeted foreign companies, engage in early-stage standardization, or pioneer frontier innovations requiring ecosystem-wide validation. Evidence from the recent U.S. sanctions on Huawei in an influential ISSO supports our hypotheses. Our findings caution policymakers that techno-nationalist controls may backfire in decentralized innovation ecosystems and alert firms to factors that can increase their vulnerability to geopolitical tensions.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于现实主义，地缘政治技术民族主义主张限制技术流向来自对手国家的目标实体，以维护国家安全和技术优势。我们在国际标准制定组织（ISSOs）中检验这一逻辑，这些组织体现了塑造下一代技术的去中心化创新生态系统。我们识别出一个悖论：技术民族主义限制会无意中削弱、而非增强本国企业相对于目标外国企业对国际标准的影响力。这一悖论之所以出现，是因为技术民族主义逻辑与去中心化创新生态系统的两个决定性特征相冲突：（1）多边互补性，即共同创造价值所需的互补知识广泛分布于各企业之间；（2）涌现性技术演化，即存在多条潜在技术轨迹，而最终的技术路径是社会建构的。这两个特征都使得ISSOs中企业之间的互动与协调对于影响标准至关重要，然而技术披露限制直接破坏了这些过程。当本国企业与目标外国公司表现出深度技术互补性、参与早期标准化，或开创需要整个生态系统验证的前沿创新时，这种反噬效应会加剧。来自近期美国在一个有影响力的ISSO中对华为实施制裁的证据支持了我们的假设。我们的发现提醒政策制定者，技术民族主义管制在去中心化创新生态系统中可能适得其反，并提醒企业注意那些可能增加其在地缘政治紧张中脆弱性的因素。

papers.abstract_original: Zahra et al. ( 2024 ) argue that prior research has insufficient understanding of the entrepreneurial nature of internationalization. To address this, they integrate theories from management and international business to develop a firm-level typology that incorporates (1) the degree of radicalness of the firm’s entrepreneurial behavior and (2) the firm’s level of foreign market commitment. We advance these efforts by proposing that, to understand what makes an internationalizing firm entrepreneurial, researchers will also benefit from direct insights from entrepreneurship research. We retain Zahra et al.’s ( 2024 ) behavioral focus in our arguments but shift attention to the individuals that guide the firm’s pursuit of international opportunity, regardless of whether the firm is a new venture or an MNE. We also argue that, when compared to typologies, a process-based perspective is better suited to both differentiating firms and to understanding and explaining the dynamic nature of entrepreneurial internationalization behavior and outcomes.
papers.abstract_zh: Zahra等人（2024）认为，既有研究对国际化的创业性质理解不足。为解决这一问题，他们整合了管理学与国际商务的理论，构建了一个企业层面的类型学，该类型学纳入了（1）企业创业行为的激进程度，以及（2）企业的海外市场承诺水平。我们推进这些努力，提出：要理解是什么使一家国际化的企业具有创业精神，研究者还将受益于创业研究的直接洞见。我们在论证中保留了Zahra等人（2024）的行为关注，但将注意力转向那些引导企业追求国际机会的个体，无论该企业是新创企业还是跨国公司。我们还认为，与类型学相比，基于过程的视角更适合于区分企业，也更适合于理解和解释创业型国际化行为与结果的动态性质。
